title: United We Box Circulate
author: Mattie Rynkiewicz
problems: Row 2 "balance & Rory O'More right · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
Row 2 "balance & Rory O'More right · slide" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
Row 3 "balance & Rory O'More left · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
Row 3 "balance & Rory O'More left · slide" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
choices: Rory O'More spins one full turn in the travel direction (the usual styling).
The balance before each Rory steps toward the slide direction first.
A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
Long waves form during the balance before each box circulate: crossers face in, loopers face out; hands join only where they reach.
